Logsheet activity Nautical timezone offset by vessel flag

UTC offset estimated from the geographic coordinates of each fishing set using the nautical timezone convention :

offset = round(longitude / 15)

Each 15° longitude band = 1 hour. This reflects how a GPS device at sea would determine local time, absent any cellular network or land-based timezone lookup.

  • Longline — log.sets_ll (l_activity_id = 1)
  • Purseseine — log.sets_ps (s_activity_id = 1)
